name: np-exact
description: Validation independent of simcount: compiled circuits of all eleven formulas against exactly computed unitaries. Part A: commuting ZZ + Z chain (Jx = Jy = 0, XX/YY kept at coefficient 0), closed-form diagonal reference, every formula must be exact. Part B: full Heisenberg chain (J = 1, periodic) against exact diagonalisation: gate-level step = product of exact exponentials, and error ~ r^-p. NumPy fields seed 1, t = n. Criteria fixed before the run (2026-11-11).

criteria._note: tol_per_exponential is ~5x the 2e-16 per exponential seen in the prototype (rounding). slope_window, slope_tol, min_points as proposed 2026-11-11 and accepted by the user. r_grid chosen so that each formula has points on both sides of the window at n = 4 in the prototype.
